title: Phone connectivity and app use
summary: Feedback on phone-related features centers on mobile connectivity, app-based functions, and smartphone dependence, with many fragments too brief or ambiguous to determine clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise reliable mobile phone connection, easy vehicle status access, and a well-designed app that works conveniently on the phone.

negative.summary: Negative feedback highlights a distracting on-screen map zoom control that is compared unfavorably with mobile phone use while driving.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention phone pairing, disconnections, smartphone requirements, and connectivity references, but the short or incomplete wording often prevents a clear sentiment reading.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are assigned undetermined sentiment, which limits confidence in a more specific thematic summary.
Several undetermined examples are very short, incomplete, or lack enough context to distinguish sentiment reliably.
The topic includes loosely related phone, app, navigation, and remote-function references, so some fragments may not describe the same underlying issue.
